overview: MPO proposes a multimodal prompt optimization framework that jointly refines textual and non-textual prompts via alignment-preserving exploration (with generation, edit, and mix operators) and efficiently selects high-performing candidates using prior-inherited Bayesian UCB, evaluated across image, video, and molecular modalities.

modules.name: Multimodal Data Processing and Loading
modules.description: Handles dataset-specific preprocessing for image (PlantVillage, CUB, SLAKE, DrivingVQA, RSVQA), video (Drive&Act, VANE-Bench), and molecular (Absorption, BBBP, CYP Inhibition) modalities, including train/test splitting, frame sampling for videos, SMILES representation for molecules, and custom Dataset/DataLoader construction with task-appropriate sampling strategies.

modules.name: MLLM Inference Wrapper
modules.description: Provides a unified interface for multimodal LLM inference (e.g., Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3) that accepts multimodal prompt pairs (textual + non-textual) and queries, returns textual outputs, and supports batched evaluation on task datasets. Also supports multiple backbone architectures (Gemma3, InternVL-3.5, GPT-4.1 nano) for generalizability experiments.

modules.name: Cohesive Backpropagation Module
modules.description: Implements failure set identification by collecting (query, answer, prediction) triples where the model's output differs from the ground truth, then generates unified cross-modal textual feedback (∇t, ∇m) that encodes weaknesses of both textual and non-textual prompt components simultaneously, ensuring a single supervisory signal guides both modalities.

modules.name: Joint Multimodal Prompt Update
modules.description: Uses the feedback from cohesive backpropagation to jointly refine the textual prompt and produce a modality-specific textual condition (c) that directs non-textual prompt revision. The optimizer LLM (e.g., GPT-4o mini) generates both the updated textual prompt (t') and the condition (c) for modality-specific generators, guaranteeing alignment between the two modalities.

modules.name: Generation Operator
modules.description: Implements the generation operator that explores entirely new non-textual prompts from scratch, conditioned only on the generation signal (c_gen) without referencing prior candidates: m' = g(c_gen, ∅). Decouples from past candidates to explore unexplored regions and avoid local optima, particularly useful in early iterations.

modules.name: Edit Operator
modules.description: Implements the edit operator that performs fine-grained refinements of non-textual prompts while retaining useful structures from the prior prompt, conditioning on both the edit condition (c_edit) and the prior non-textual prompt: m' = g(c_edit, {m}). Enables targeted incremental refinements for already-strong prompts.

modules.name: Mix Operator
modules.description: Implements the mix operator that blends complementary strengths of multiple (K) multimodal prompts by synthesizing feedback from multiple parents into a mixing condition (c_mix), then combining non-textual prompts: m' = g(c_mix, {m_1,...,m_K}). Produces balanced compositions and explores intermediate solutions.

modules.name: Modality-Specific Generator Interface
modules.description: Provides a unified abstraction for modality-specific generators (text-to-image: GPT-Image/SANA1.5; text-to-video: Wan2.1; text-to-molecule: GPT-4o mini) that accept textual conditions and optional reference non-textual inputs, producing updated non-textual prompts. Supports lightweight open-source generators for cost efficiency.

modules.name: Beam Search Exploration Loop
modules.description: Implements the iterative optimization loop using beam search: at each iteration, selects top-b performing multimodal prompts, applies cohesive backpropagation and joint multimodal update with randomly sampled operators (generation/edit/mix) to produce b² child prompts, then passes candidates to the selection module. First iteration uses only the generation operator since no non-textual prompts exist yet.

modules.name: Prior-Inherited Bayesian UCB Selection
modules.description: Implements the prompt selection strategy that models each candidate's expected score as a Beta distribution with informative priors inherited from parent prompt performance: α_i = μ̂_par(i)·S + 1, β_i = (1-μ̂_par(i))·S + 1. Iteratively selects the prompt with the highest UCB score (upper quantile of Beta posterior), evaluates on small data batches, updates posteriors, and returns top-b prompts after budget exhaustion.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Implements task-specific evaluation metrics: accuracy for image/video classification and QA tasks, F1 score for molecular tasks (handling class imbalance), DSG (Davidsonian Scene Graph) score for cross-modal alignment measurement, and answer correctness extraction (predefined label extraction for classification, strict formatting for binary/closed-ended QA, exact match for open-ended QA).

modules.name: Baseline Prompt Optimization Methods
modules.description: Implements text-only automatic prompt optimization baselines for comparison: APE (reverse-engineering instructions and paraphrasing), OPRO (LLM-as-optimizer with prompt-score pairs), EvoPrompt (evolutionary mutation/crossover), PE2 (meta-prompt optimization), ProTeGi (textual gradient descent with beam search), and SEE (cohesive instruction + in-context example optimization).

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Supports controlled ablation experiments: modality contribution ablation (text-only vs image-only vs full multimodal), operator ablation (generation/edit/mix individually vs combined), selection strategy comparison (Uniform, UCB, w/o Prior, Prior-Inherited Bayesian UCB), and alignment strategy analysis (Sequential, Random Image Prompt, In-Distribution Image Query, OOD Image Query).

modules.name: Cross-Modal Alignment and Hidden State Analysis
modules.description: Computes DSG scores for measuring cross-modal consistency between textual and non-textual prompt components, performs parent-child performance correlation analysis, and visualizes MLLM hidden states via PCA of intermediate-layer embeddings to demonstrate that multimodal prompts shift representations into distinct semantic regions unavailable from text alone.

modules.name: Efficiency and Sensitivity Analysis
modules.description: Implements computational cost analysis (model request/call counting), budget efficiency comparison (evaluation savings percentage across selection strategies), prior strength sensitivity analysis (sweeping hyperparameter S and reporting performance), training dynamics tracking (test score vs iteration curves), and backbone generalizability assessment across varying base models, optimizer models, and generator models.

modules.name: Configuration, Logging, and Result Aggregation
modules.description: Manages YAML/JSON-based experiment configurations (beam size, iteration count, evaluation budget, prior strength, temperatures), logging and monitoring (training curves, optimization trajectories), model checkpoint persistence (best prompt saving/loading), and automated result aggregation across three independent runs with LaTeX table generation and qualitative prompt visualization.
